back: Affordable, simple technology that local people can operate and repair, suited to the farm's scale.
Rising piston lowers pressure → air pressure pushes water in through inlet valve → falling piston pushes it out through outlet valve.
Air pressure pushes the water up, so suction lift is limited (theory under about 10 m; in practice a few metres).
Primed; impeller spins and flings water into volute casing; speed becomes pressure; low pressure at the eye draws more in.
Filling the casing and suction pipe with water before starting a centrifugal pump.
Replace seals and valves, oil/grease moving parts, clean strainer, check engine oil, fuel, air filter, belts and gland.

front: Parts of a hand disc maize sheller
back: Hopper/throat, toothed disc, handle and flywheel, spring-loaded pressure plate, grain and cob outlets.
Beater rubs pods against a perforated screen; kernels and shells fall through; winnow to separate.
Dry crop, remove stones, adjust settings, feed steadily, guards on, hands clear, stop engine to clear blockages, dust mask.
